//_1: TEMPLATE - Copy to .vscode/settings.json (per-repo, committed) OR merge into your User settings.json (all projects). Windows User path: %APPDATA%/Code/User/settings.json.
//_2: This file uses unique //_ keys as comments so it stays STRICT valid JSON. In a real .vscode/settings.json you may also use // line comments (JSONC).
//_customization: Make Copilot read your instruction/prompt files.
//_concise: Always-on rules that keep answers short = fewer output tokens.

github.copilot.chat.codeGeneration.instr.text: Be concise. Don't restate the question or the plan. Show only changed code.
Match the existing style of the file you're editing. No apologies or filler.

github.copilot.chat.testGeneration.instr.text: Arrange-Act-Assert, one behaviour per test, cover an edge case, no real network.

github.copilot.chat.reviewSelection.inst.text: Report only high-confidence bugs/security/logic issues. No style nitpicks.

github.copilot.chat.commitMessageGenerat.text: Conventional Commits. Imperative subject <=50 chars; terse body only if useful.

github.copilot.chat.pullRequestDescripti.text: Bullet what changed and why, based only on the diff. Under 200 words. No fluff.

//_agent: Agent mode / auto-approval. Keep autoApprove OFF and cap runs to avoid runaway token use. Flip specific tools to true only when you trust them.
//_completions: Inline suggestions: enable broadly, disable where noise isn't helpful.
//_hygiene: Smaller, consistent diffs = the model reads/rewrites less on every edit.
//_noise: Keep junk out of search/context so it never enters the model's window.
